definition_quote.value: Practice of emergency medical care means the performance of any act using judgment or skill based upon the United States Department of Transportation education standards and guideline training requirements, the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration's National Emergency Medical Service Scope of Practice Model and National Emergency Medical Services Education Standards, an education program for a community paramedic or a critical care paramedic that is approved by the board and the Department of Health and Human Services, and permitted practices and procedures for the level of licensure listed in section 38-1217.
definition_quote.quote: Practice of emergency medical care means the performance of any act using judgment or skill based upon the United States Department of Transportation education standards and guideline training requirements, the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration's National Emergency Medical Service Scope of Practice Model and National Emergency Medical Services Education Standards, an education program for a community paramedic or a critical care paramedic that is approved by the board and the Department of Health and Human Services, and permitted practices and procedures for the level of licensure listed in section 38-1217.

ambulance_service_license_required.quote: An emergency medical service validly licensed for emergency transport may transport a law enforcement canine injured in the line of duty

value: Emergency Medical Responder: contributing to assessment, simple noninvasive interventions, minimizing secondary injury
Emergency Medical Technician: all EMR acts, simple invasive interventions, management and transportation, nonvisualized intubation
Advanced Emergency Medical Technician: all EMT acts, complex interventions, treatments, and pharmacological interventions
Emergency Medical Technician-Intermediate: all AEMT acts, visualized intubation (terminates December 31, 2025)
Paramedic: all AEMT acts, visualized intubation, surgical cricothyrotomy
Community Paramedic: telephone triage, chronic disease management, posthospital discharge followup, all acts of respective level
Critical Care Paramedic: all paramedic acts, advanced clinical patient assessment, intravenous infusions, complex critical care interventions
scope_of_practice_by_level.quote: Such care includes, but is not limited to, (1) all of the acts that an advanced emergency medical technician is authorized to perform, (2) visualized intubation, (3) surgical cricothyrotomy, and (4) until December 31, 2025, all of the acts that an emergency medical technician-intermediate is authorized to perform.

treatment_of_police_dogs_authorized.quote: An emergency care provider may provide emergency medical care to a law enforcement canine injured in the line of duty while at the scene of an emergency or while a law enforcement canine is being transported to a veterinary clinic or similar facility

civil_immunity_for_good_faith_care.quote: An emergency care provider who acts in good faith to provide emergency medical care to an injured law enforcement canine pursuant to subsection (2) or (3) of this section shall be immune from criminal or civil liability.
